definitions.explanation: A building where films are shown to an audience.

examples.japanese: {映画館|えいがかん}で{新|あたら}しい{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ました。
examples.english: I watched a new movie at the theater.

examples.japanese: この{映画館|えいがかん}は{音|おと}がいいです。
examples.english: This movie theater has good sound.

examples.japanese: {映画館|えいがかん}の{チケット|ちけっと}を{予約|よやく}しました。

notes:
{映画館|えいがかん} is a compound of {映画|えいが} (movie) + {館|かん} (hall/building).

ALTERNATIVE WORDS:
- シネマ: cinema (loanword)
- シアター: theater (loanword)
- {劇場|げきじょう}: theater (formal)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {映画館|えいがかん}に{行|い}く: to go to the movies
- {映画館|えいがかん}で{見|み}る: to watch at the theater
- {映画館|えいがかん}の{席|せき}: movie theater seat

JAPAN-SPECIFIC:
- Tickets often reserved in advance with assigned seats
- {映画|えいが}の{日|ひ} (Movie Day, 1st of each month): discounted tickets
- Talking during movies is considered very rude
- Many theaters offer premium options like 4DX, IMAX

OTHER {館|かん} BUILDINGS:
- {図書館|としょかん}: library
- {美術館|びじゅつかん}: art museum
- {水族館|すいぞくかん}: aquarium
